entities.summary: Vladimir Efimovich Gorev, known as Vladimir Gorev, was a Belarusian soldier known to have participated in the defense of Madrid as a Soviet military advisor during the Spanish Civil War. He was born in 1900 in Velizh, Vitebsk Governorate. He was of Belarusian ethnicity.
